card.statement: Let $v\in M_i$ be a nonzero element such that $\deg_{x^+}(v)=0$. Then there exists $u_1\in U$ such that $u_1(v)=x_i^{-1}$. Moreover, $U(x_i^{-1})=M_i$.
card.label: Lemma 28

paper.title: Localization of free field realizations of affine Lie algebras
paper.abstract: We use localization technique to construct new families of irreducible modules of affine Kac-Moody algebras. In particular, localization is applied to the first free field realization of the affine Lie algebra A_1^{(1)} or, equivalently, to imaginary Verma modules.
